mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate the CNS effects of prednisolone and increase risk of hypertension; prednisolone can enhance sympathomimetic effects and mood destabilization in MAOI-treated patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and watch for signs of hypomania, agitation, or mood changes; use lowest effective prednisolone dose and consider alternative corticosteroid if possible.
